fact: A balance earns the USDe base rate, which Ethena Pay does not set, and the Daily Boost tops it up to the tier's total rate. The headline of up to 6% a year is that total, base included
section: What is the Daily Boost; 3.3 Daily Boost Incentive

fact: The Boost is the tier's total rate less the base rate. It narrows if the base rate rises and is zero if the base rate exceeds the total
Standard 5% a year on balance up to $5,000, Pro 6% up to $100,000, VIP 6% up to $1,000,000. Balance above the cap earns the base rate only
The Boost accrues daily on the time-weighted average daily value of Eligible Balances and is paid daily in USDe, ordinarily within 24 hours after the close of the accrual day, Central European Time
section: What is the Daily Boost; 6.6(a) and 6.6(d); 3.3

fact: The Boost accrues on a day only if, during the calendar month of that day, the user has completed at least one Qualifying Card Transaction or other qualifying activity Ethena Pay specifies. No Boost accrues on a day for which the month's activity requirement is not met
section: 6.6(c) and 6.6(h)(iv); What is the Daily Boost; 3.3

fact: A Qualifying Card Transaction is a settled purchase with the Ethena Pay card at a merchant, in a supported currency, not reversed or refunded, with an eligible merchant category
A card transaction is authorized when the card is used and settles later, usually within one to three business days
Eligible Balances are supported assets in the account that are not pledged, frozen or under a hold, and within minimum and maximum thresholds
Per-user, per-household, per-device and aggregate program caps might apply
The Daily Boost is a discretionary promotional incentive that can be reduced to zero, funded from marketing and incentive budgets, and is not interest or yield
The Daily Boost is not available where offering it would need a license Ethena Pay does not hold
The user's tier is shown in the app's enrollment details. The pages read do not say how a user becomes Pro or VIP
Very small cashback amounts are carried forward until they reach the minimum that can be transferred. The pages say nothing about a minimum for the Boost
